name: Smile and Wave
description: Each creature of the creature’s choice that is within 30 feet of the creature must succeed on a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw or be magically charmed by the creature for 1 hour. A charmed target must move on its turn toward the creature, trying to get within 5 feet of the creature. The target doesn’t move into obviously dangerous ground, such as a fire or a pit. Whenever the charmed target takes damage, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. A target that successfully saves is immune to any guide’s Smile and Wave ability for the next 24 hours.
